chunks: He said: "How long did you live on the earth in terms of years?"

key_terms.عَدَدَ سِنِينَ: A number of years/count of years

ai.seo_question: What question is asked to disbelievers in Surah Al-Mu'minun regarding their time on earth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical question underscores the illusion of worldly permanence, contrasting the fleeting nature of dunya with the eternal reality of the Hereafter. It serves as a profound reminder for believers to evaluate their deeds against the brevity of their lifespan, emphasizing that true success lies in spiritual preparation rather than material accumulation.
